name: patterson-corp
description: Patterson Companies enterprise agent plugins. The top layer of the Patterson agent platform: standards, brand, and shared capability that applies across every sub-organization.

plugins.name: patterson-engineering
plugins.description: Encodes Patterson's IT standards for CI/CD, Azure environments, compute, storage and data classification, and monitoring. Sourced from the ServiceNow IT Standards & Guidelines knowledge base. Relevant to engineers, SREs, platform, and architecture roles authoring or reviewing a CI/CD pipeline, provisioning Azure infrastructure, classifying data or choosing storage, configuring monitoring and alerting, or checking whether a tool is approved for use at Patterson.

plugins.name: patterson-brand
plugins.description: Patterson Companies brand identity, design tokens, and editorial voice. Ships a drop-in Tailwind v4 + shadcn/ui theme derived from the 2025 Brand Guide. Relevant to designers, engineers, marketers, and writers building Patterson-branded UI, starting a frontend project that needs Patterson styling, writing customer-facing or internal copy, reviewing work for brand compliance, or building a presentation or document from a Patterson template.
